title: Outdoors & Travel
dek: Bags that make packing easy, plus gear for a weekend at camp or an evening in the backyard.

boards.title: Pack and go
boards.dek: A duffel, a carry-on pack and the cubes that keep them organized.

boards.title: Weekend camp
boards.dek: Chairs, a hammock, a cooler and a lantern for two nights out.

boards.title: Backyard evenings
boards.dek: Two fire pits and a lantern for the patio.

items.name: Black Hole Duffel Bag 55L
items.why: CleverHiker named it the best all-around duffel: weather-resistant 900-denier ripstop made from recycled polyester, with backpack straps, a padded base and lash points. The trade-off is little inside organization and no compression.

items.name: Travel Backpack 45L
items.why: A carry-on pack that zips from 35 to 45 liters and opens fully from the front and sides. A reviewer who has used it for four years still ranks it among his top three bags, though he says the harness suits airports and hotels better than long walks.

items.name: Packing Cube
items.why: Each cube has an internal divider that keeps clean and dirty clothes apart, plus a zip that expands or compresses it. The cubes are sized to fit Peak Design's travel packs.

items.name: Pack-It Isolate Packing Cube Set (XS/S/M)
items.why: Three see-through cubes in water-resistant recycled 70D nylon that weigh about 3 oz together. The Savvy Backpacker found the earlier Specter version of these ultralight cubes thin but tough, and they are covered by Eagle Creek's No Matter What warranty.
items.ebay: eagle creek pack-it isolate cube set

items.name: Chair One
items.why: A camp chair that weighs about 2 lb and packs to 14 x 4.5 x 4.5 inches, yet holds 320 lb. Gripped's reviewer found its aluminum frame stronger than some home furniture and comfortable enough for everyday use.

items.name: Roo Double Camping Hammock
items.why: OutdoorGearLab gave it an Editors' Choice as the best everyday lounger: soft, quick-drying fabric, a 500 lb limit and Dyneema slings, and it packs to about the size of a water bottle. Tree straps are sold separately.

items.name: Roadie 24 Hard Cooler
items.why: Switchback Travel's testers kept food cold for three summer days in this 24-quart rotomolded cooler, which is tall enough for upright wine bottles. They note it is pricey for its size and has no drain plug.

items.name: Beacon Hanging Light
items.why: A rechargeable LED lantern that hangs over a picnic table or from a tent loop. It puts out 30 to 220 lumens in warm 3000K light and runs more than 200 hours on low.

items.name: X Series 24 Smokeless Fire Pit
items.why: A US-made fire pit that GearJunkie called one of the nicest smokeless systems it has tested; you can choose Corten steel, which weathers to a patina, or stainless. It weighs 62 lb, so it is a backyard fixture rather than a portable pit.

items.name: Stargaze Reclining Camp Chair
items.why: A camp chair hung from a low aluminum frame, so it swings like a hammock and reclines when you lean back. CNN Underscored's tester called it the most comfortable camp chair they had tried, but found it hard to get out of and its cup holders shallow.

items.name: Bonfire Fire Pit with Stand 2.0
items.why: A 19.5-inch stainless steel fire pit that weighs about 25 lb with its stand. Popular Science's reviewer found that its airflow all but eliminates smoke once the fire is going, and its removable ash pan makes cleanup easy. The sides do get hot.

items.name: Railroad Lantern
items.why: A rechargeable LED lantern styled like an old railroad lamp, with 35 to 200 lumens and more than 100 hours of run time on low. It is at home on a patio table or hung from a hook.
